events.text: I need to cancel my order, it's still showing as being prepared. My plans changed and I won't be home to get it.
I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on it.
Sure. My full name is Fatima Zahra, and the email on the account is fatima.zahra@mailbox.example.

Thank you, Fatima, you're verified. I'm sorry, but I can't cancel order Q-8101. The app still shows it as "preparing", but the courier log shows the courier picked it up at 7:27 PM. Once an order has been picked up, it can't be cancelled or have its address changed.

Here are some options:
- If someone else can be at 400 Summit Ave to take the order, it can still be delivered as planned.
- If the order doesn't reach you, contact us again after the delivery attempt. What we can do then depends on what happened during delivery.

Is there anything else I can help with?
Wait, I'm confused. The app still says preparing, so how can it already have been picked up? My order number is 8101, not Q-8101, is that the same thing?

Yes, 8101 and Q-8101 are the same order. It's your Green Bowl order from 6:50 PM today, for $43.61. It's the only recent order on your account.

The status in the app can lag behind what's happening. When the two disagree, I go by the courier's event log, because it records what actually happened in delivery. That log shows the courier was assigned at 6:51 PM and picked up the order at 7:27 PM. The "preparing" label is out of date.

Because of the pickup, I can't cancel it or refund it. The order is on its way, with a promised delivery time of 7:40 PM. If someone can receive it at your address, that's the best option.

I'm not going to be home, so nobody can take it. Are you sure it was picked up? The app still says preparing and I haven't gotten any notice that a courier has it. Can you at least check whether there's a refund option, or do I have to just deal with the food showing up with nobody there?

Yes, I'm sure. The courier's event log has a `picked_up` event at 7:27 PM. That log is the record I have to go by, and it overrides the app's status label.

I also checked refund options, and there aren't any for this situation. Our policy allows a refund or credit when an order is late, has missing or wrong items, or was cancelled before pickup. A change of plans after pickup isn't covered. If the courier can't reach you or can't complete the delivery, that also isn't eligible for a refund or credit.

Here is what you can do:
- Ask someone you trust to be at 400 Summit Ave around 7:40 PM to take the food.
- Make sure your phone is reachable so the courier can contact you.

Once the order arrives, there are still cases where I can help. If it's very late, or items are missing or wrong, contact us and I'll review it. If you'd like a person to look at your situation, tell me and I'll pass it to a specialist.

I'm really frustrated. I'm not home and I'm not going to have anyone there. The app says preparing and nobody has told me a courier has it. I don't want food showing up to an empty house, and I don't want to pay $43.61 for nothing. Please pass me to a specialist.

args.summary: Customer (verified) asked to cancel Q-8101 (Green Bowl, $43.61) because plans changed and nobody will be home. Delivery events show picked_up at 19:27, so cancellation and refund were not allowed under policy, though the app still showed "preparing". Customer is frustrated, says she got no notice of courier pickup, and asked to speak to a specialist.

events.text:
I've passed your case to a specialist, and they will follow up with you within 24 hours. I've given them the details: you asked to cancel because you won't be home, the courier picked the order up at 7:27 PM, and the app still showed "preparing" with no pickup notice. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

I'm sorry for the frustration. The app's status didn't match what was happening with your order. If you can, keep your phone reachable in case the courier tries to contact you.

Okay, I hear you. A specialist within 24 hours doesn't help me much right now, though, because the food could be at my door in about 15 minutes with nobody home. Is there any way to stop the courier from delivering, or to have it left somewhere safe? And can you confirm in writing that I've asked for a refund so I have a record of it?

I can't stop the courier or set up a safe place for the food. Once an order has been picked up, I can't change its address or cancel it, and I have no way to send instructions to the courier. These are the options I can offer:

- **Reach the courier.** If the app lets you call or message the courier, ask them directly to wait or leave the food somewhere safe. I can't promise they'll agree.
- **Have someone receive it.** A neighbor or a friend at 400 Summit Ave could take it.

**Written record:** this chat is a record of your request. In this conversation, you:
- Asked to cancel order Q-8101 (Green Bowl, $43.61, Visa ending 4242) at about 7:30 PM on October 24, 2026, because your plans changed.
- Were told it couldn't be cancelled, because the courier log shows pickup at 7:27 PM.
- Asked for a refund and for a specialist.
- Were escalated under reference **ESC-700**, with follow-up within 24 hours.

I haven't issued a refund, and I can't say what the specialist will decide. You can quote ESC-700 in any later contact.

Okay. I don't have anyone who can take it, and I can't reach the courier from here. I'll keep ESC-700 and wait for the specialist. I'm not happy about this, but I understand it's not something you can change right now.
